component.notes:
Lyrion Sonos-Matrix. A virtual 16x16 audio matrix that groups Sonos rooms through Lyrion + the Savant Sonos Bridge plugin. Nothing is physically wired.
Setup: - IP address = Lyrion server (port 9000). - For each Sonos room N (a Lyrion Sonos-Soundbar / Sonos-Speaker component): room SONOS GROUP OUT -> matrix SONOS GROUP IN N matrix SONOS GROUP OUT N -> room SONOS GROUP IN and enter that room's Lyrion player ID (e.g. bb:bb:12:34:56:01) in state variable RoomN_PlayerID. - Blueprint then builds every room's music service in every zone; sharing a service to another room makes that room's Sonos join the source room's Sonos group (Sonos keeps them in sync). - Turning a room off (output off) makes its Sonos leave the group. Inputs are never routed to their own output (a room doesn't follow itself). ====================== Change Log ================== Version: 1.0 Change: Initial release.
